Facts: Liu bought disabled persons' personal info (25,751 records) and phone, bank cards etc. Then used info to call victims, pretended to be civil affairs bureau staff, defrauded them of 302,840 yuan transferred to accounts. So two crimes: (1) Fraud (诈骗) – specifically "诈骗罪" (fraud) with large amount.
